output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. Getting around to our christmas breakfast and wanted to see if we could get the back room Saturday Dec 19 at 7am, same as always. If the 19th is no good could you do the 12th instead? We'd rather have the 19th if you got it, there's a reason for that I'll get to in a minute.

Dwayne sent me the list and right now we have 24 counting Earl and his wife Carol. Thats 19 drivers, 3 from the shop and those two. Can you handle that many in the back room? I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you asked last year so you're not fixing food for people that aren't coming. I'll take care of getting that to you.

We'd like to do the same food as last time if that still works for you, the big pans of eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy, and everybody orders there own meat off the menu. The $11 a head was fair and if its gone up a little thats fine, just let me know what it is now so I can tell everybody. Separate checks again please, that worked good for us. Is the bottomless coffee still included?

Couple things on the food and getting in. Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you have that would work for her instead? Let me know what you can do and if thats a different price. Also Lonnie is on a walker since his hip and can't manage the steps. Can we have him come through the side door with no steps, and could you have that unlocked for him at 7? We'd want enough room for him to get the walker through to his seat too.

Now the part we need to keep quiet. Earl is retiring after 31 years driving and his last day is the 18th, so the breakfast would be the next morning if we get the 19th. He doesn't know we're planning anything for him and Carol wants it kept that way. Please don't mention it if you see him. We don't need a big speech or anything, he'd be embarrassed, just something little from all of us.

Could we bring a cake from Sugarcreek or would you rather do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle? Honestly your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake and Earl loves them, so I'd lean that way if you can do it. What would a tray for this bunch cost? If we go with the cake is it alright to bring it in, and is there any charge for that? Sugarcreek needs 5 days notice so I'd want to get that settled ahead of time.

One last thing, you mentioned having a backup for the coffee after the urn quit last year around 8:15. I know you felt bad and those things happen. Could we make sure there's a spare pot ready this time? This bunch does go through the coffee lol.

Let me know what works. We always enjoy coming down there and appreciate you having us every year.

Thanks,
Gary
